bibl.title: Two Private Prayers in Wall Inscriptions in the Faras Cathedral.
bibl.seg: Adam Łajtar & Grzegorz Ochała, Two Private Prayers in Wall Inscriptions in the Faras Cathedral.
bibl.note: 1. Prayer for Kinyakouda (?): Greek inscription modelled on Ps. 85:1-2. - 2. Prayer for Arwa: Old Nubian original composition with information about the protagonist and the author in Greek.
